review_description: I contacted several installers before choosingRAF Power, and I'm glad I did. Rafeeq was incredibly helpful from the start-providing detailed advice and answering all my questions thoroughly. He even recommended joining a local Perth solar group on Facebook, which helped me understand that the cheapest quote isn't always the best. Rafeeq's pricing was competitive, and he took great care to ensure the entire process was smooth. My installation included a full upgrade: 10kW solar system, 8kW inverter, and a 22kWh battery. I made a last-minute change to the inverter size, and Rafeeq guided me through it with no hassle. If you're considering solar, I highly recommend RAF Power for their professionalism, transparency, and customer-first approach.
Rafeek from RAF power was with me every step of  the way and it is the second major installation from him for a house I bought.Reliable, approachable, excellent customer service, recommend!
